# Citation / 授奖理由

Template only. A candidate narrative must explicitly identify its pending status.

## English

Describe the solved problem, significance, scoring rationale, evidence, and unresolved review questions. Do not claim a candidate has received an award.

## 中文

说明已解决题目、意义、评分理由、证据及尚未解决的审查问题。候选材料须明确标为候选，不得发布获奖结论。
